title: negotiated-data-residency-tiers-sccs-and-retention-experiment
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Enterprise customers regularly request explicit data residency guarantees (EU/UK), control around subprocessors, and contractual language (SCCs/UK Addendum) that materially affect price and go-to-contract timelines. We need an experiment to prototype tiered residency/retention packaging, a defined subprocessor handling workflow, and a small priced offering to execute SCCs/UK addenda in negotiation so sales can close faster without open-ended legal work.

Goals: (1) Increase contract close rate and reduce sales cycle for deals requiring EU/UK residency or SCCs by 30% within the quarter. (2) Validate willingness to pay for: per-region residency tier, premium retention windows, and a one-time SCC/UK addendum execution fee. (3) Deliver a templated operational playbook for Legal/Sales/Customer Success to onboard customers under these terms.

Scope: Design three residency tiers (hosted-global, hosted-eu-only, private-vpc) with associated default retention windows (30d, 90d, custom) and clear subprocessor commitments. Define and price: SCC automation add-on (one-time execution + guarantee), extended retention pricing (per GB/month), and a residency SLA uplift surcharge for guaranteed EU-only processing. Build contract clause templates and a subprocessor publication workflow. This ticket drives the packaging and experiments; engineering/legal tasks are listed as dependencies and action items.
acceptance_criteria: Draft tier definitions and pricing for 3 residency tiers agreed by PM/Legal/Finance
SCCs and UK Addendum template language signed off by Legal and placed in Confluence
Sales playbook and negotiation script published with decision tree for when to offer which tier
Pilot pricing offer created for 5 enterprise prospects; at least 2 engage and provide willingness-to-pay feedback
Measurement plan instrumented in CRM to track time-to-sign, discounting, and churn for residency deals
tasks: Workshop with Legal to finalize subprocessor commitment language and SCC operational steps
Model pricing impact with Finance: per-customer capacity, expected margin delta, and ARR uplift scenarios
Create Confluence page with clause templates, delegation matrix, and required artifacts for sales
Prepare sales-facing one-pager and negotiation script; run enablement session with AE team
Set up pilot proposals in Salesforce and tag opportunities for experiment tracking
Coordinate with Eng to get residency capability matrix (region coverage, private install constraints) and time-to-provision estimates
notes: 2026-02-11: Initial scoping with Sales/Legal; Sales reported 7 active opportunities blocked by SCCs or EU residency requirements.
2026-02-18: Finance provided a baseline model; EU-only hosting adds ~22% infra cost at scale (GPU pinned pools + egress compliance).
2026-02-27: Legal prefers a one-time SCC execution service fee and to avoid blanket delegation for subprocessors; recommends public subprocessor list and quarterly notification cadence.
2026-03-05: Design provided a simple UI mock for residency selection on sign-up and an add-on flow for SCCs; DES-4120 assigned for assets.
2026-03-09: Proposed pilot customers identified (2 fintech, 1 healthtech, 2 adtech) — Sales agreed to run pilot proposals in March.
Next steps: finalize pricing bands by 2026-03-17, lock templates with Legal by 2026-03-24, start pilot offers week of 2026-03-30.
